comparison_notes: Seeds vary paired projection initialization and minibatch order; both are identical across all four arms within a seed.
The 2x2 factors are tangent/elliptic features and pointwise/causal tied-QKV mixing. All arms have 8450 trainable parameters, not equal expressivity or compute.
Causal scores are feature dot products divided by 3, not geodesic distances. Only full unpadded contexts are admitted; model KV cache is disabled.
Geometry owns both features and backward in Rust. The ordinary causal control uses explicit Torch attention with f64 intermediates; parity is tolerance-based, not bitwise execution identity.

Compare elliptic minus tangent separately within pointwise and causal paths; compare causal minus pointwise within each map. Report their difference-in-differences per seed, without claiming significance.
Pride and Alice endpoints have already been inspected. This is exploratory reuse, not pristine held-out confirmation.
The pointwise arms are rerun under this exact native/runtime/source binding; historical outcomes are references, not replacements for paired runs.
No speed advantage, resident WGPU execution, padding-mask or KV-cache support is claimed.
